name: Page header
summary: Top of a page in a portal or dashboard: breadcrumbs, title (h1), description, actions and optional tabs.
use: At the top of every page in a portal.
avoid: The heading of a block inside a page: use the title of Card, Table or Description list.
figmaProps: On mobile the actions go below the title. Bind to breakpoint/page-header (Apply variable).
Show breadcrumbs / description / actions / secondary action / tabs / divider
reactProps: On by default, off when there are tabs.
behaviour: Actions wrap to a new line when there is no room.
a11y: Breadcrumbs in a nav with an aria-label.
content: Title = where you are, the same as the menu item.
Description in one sentence: what you can do here.
do: One primary action. If it is in the header, do not also put it in the table.
dont: More than 3 actions: put the rest in a DropdownMenu.
